title: One-dimensional partial actions of 8-dimensional Hopf algebras and right coideal subalgebras
summary: In this work, we complete the description of the one-dimensional partial actions of 8-dimensional Hopf algebras by computing the remaining cases: the Kac-Paljutkin algebra $\mathcal{A}$ and the unique non-semisimple non-pointed Hopf algebra $\mathcal{K}$. We prove that all these partial actions are symmetric, study their associated partial smash products and we determine all their partial coactions of dimension one.
